before_versions.strategy:
Covers two related outputs of the same commission: the customer-facing report body and the separate customer issue-reference Excel/annex.

A. Report-body voice. Do NOT carry a 编写说明-style narrative about how the document was compiled, and do NOT insert self-referential statements about the writing system's own role, presence or participation. Observed defect class 1 — selected trial text (report block still present after the earlier attendance disclaimer had been removed): "一、编写说明 1. 本报告基于本次提交的前置资料编写… 2. 签名、联系方式、签到表、人员照片及个人姓名未作为编写输入… 3. 原件均已保留；导入读取失败或图像未识别的部分属本轮资料接入范围所限，不等于客户未提供资料… 4. 暂时不能确定的内容未作推测性填写…". Observed defect class 2 — participation disclaimer such as "系统不在现场" / "本系统未参加任何现场活动". Customer's stated reasons: "its a report generation system to help people generate report. The final output should be no difference with people. While human generated report won't say that ' 系统不在现场'. And then, the logic of writing the report do require evidence to prove the conclusion. Thus why the customer provide '专家签名'，现场核查, etc." — conclusions are carried by the cited evidence documents (expert signatures, survey records), not by statements about the writer. Destination confirmed by the customer: "yes, this kind of description should not appear in report? but is ok in excel" — such operational notes belong in the separate issue-reference Excel, not in the report.

B. Practical handling. (a) Drop the process narrative and all role/participation disclaimers from the report body. (b) Keep every substantive statement attributed to its source document ("据〈来源文件〉记载"), because that attribution is what carries the evidence-to-conclusion discipline. (c) Keep the substantive 未决事项 items (unresolved data differences, missing approval documents) in the report — they concern the report's own conclusions. (d) Where a read/OCR failure materially affects one item, state it once, factually and locally, as that item's coverage boundary (e.g. the scanned《外业验收专家审查意见落实情况表》could not be read, so its per-item implementation is not transcribed) rather than as a general self-referential explanation. (e) Place the general input/process notes and the "does not mean the customer failed to supply material" framing in the separate Excel / boundary note, clearly marked as not part of the final report.

C. Excel scope. The Excel is a separate customer reference whose stated purpose is customer reference to issues found in the report; it is not part of the final report and is not a carrier for report-body reference data. Observed defect class 3 — the workbook carried report-body data categories: sheet names "1.2 主要技术标准", "1.4 主要工程数量", "先行段桥梁设置" plus a 主要技术标准 table (公路等级/车道数量/设计速度/路基宽度…). Customer: "another found is the '主要技术标准' appear in the excel, the excel is not part of the final report. The only purpose is for customer references about issue found in report. Why '主要技术标准' appears here? What is the purpose?". So keep the workbook limited to the issues found in the report (with the report's issue numbering/pointers); do not add report-body data tables/sections unless the customer has separately confirmed that need. The input/process/boundary note is the permitted exception, presented as an explicit 用途/边界 statement.

D. The customer also raised, as an open discussion rather than a rule: "if the writer just collect material and write the report but not pretend himself the engineer, may he be not confuse by the role?" — the working reading is neutral report voice plus evidence attribution, with no role claims and no role disclaimers either way; the authorship/voice question itself remains to be settled with the customer. This entry is self-contained: it relies on no other experience entry.
